intent: Replication on two intake_03 training-source terrains outside the estimator's fit and earlier evaluation. Registered before this investigator inspected their worker-order consequences. These are prospective analyses of existing trajectories, not new policy games.
eligible: Inspect all recorded planter roots with real v1's NONE, a strictly positive pre-action price, and can_pay_now after friendly costs/reservations, plus an entry-legal conflict-free movement from extract.pair. Do not condition on later payment or survival. Other source commands are held as submitted. At most one prospective order per physical seat/turn per rule, choose first triggered worker in lexicographic public UID order; also report all isolated triggers. Changing one worker now has no implied later-policy trajectory.
choice: Given a v1 hold, extract.pair chooses the legal neighbor minimizing sha256(seed|seat|turn|uid|cmd) in pre-action opportunity data. It takes no opponent simultaneous command or next state. Probabilities use only acting-seat observation, own approved orders, and three preceding public observations. Fire on p_stay >= .20 and p_stay >= p_move + .05. Otherwise retain all original commands.
comparators: Same-eligibility, same physical moves and tie-breaking for each rule. Binary public reach veto uses 1 for threatened, 0 for unthreatened, and the same .20/.05 cutoffs. An additional probability baseline uses the frozen training-only contact_constant within that envelope, 0 outside; identical thresholds. Always-v1 uses no veto.
evaluation: For each seat, map and all four source trajectories record all roots, retained opportunities, actual vetoes, direction of deaths and missed preventable deaths among feasible roots. Itemize lost original same-turn focal acquisitions and observed debits. Geometric and estimated-rate flags are scored on the exact same opportunities. A root where both arms die is separately counted; missed preventable means v1 dies and the preselected alternative survives but no veto was issued. Give counts and equal-map descriptive results. No refitting, terminal-return or win-rate claims and no final exam.
compute: Reuse source, frozen opportunity generator, sample extractor and official Board versus FastCarbon step on original and alternative with actual simultaneous non-focal orders, with per-map/seat progress. One low-priority CPU, after ongoing validation extraction.
